label: Set each company currency from its existing money rows

execute.description: copy the single existing data currency onto each company
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."companies" c SET "currency" = u."currency" FROM (SELECT "companyId", min("currency") AS "currency" FROM (SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchants" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchant_plans" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."delivery_zones" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."shipments" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."cod_collections" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchant_ledger_entries" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchant_settlements" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."settlement_payments" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchant_settlement_requests") a GROUP BY "companyId") u WHERE u."companyId" = c."id"

postcheck.description: ensure every money row now matches its company currency
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchants" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchant_plans" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."delivery_zones" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."shipments" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."cod_collections" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchant_ledger_entries" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchant_settlements" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."settlement_payments" UNION SELECT "companyId", "currency" FROM "public"."merchant_settlement_requests") u JOIN "public"."companies" c ON c."id" = u."companyId" WHERE c."currency" <> u."currency") AS "result"
